basis: Structured expression of the predeclared expectations in selection-composition-protocol.json, informed by retained exact source text. These labels never add a card to a selection.

profiles.relationship: Qualifying death triggers opponents' creature sacrifice
profiles.qualification: Actual trigger also accepts token deaths; a nontoken death can satisfy it. Interactive output is not an exclusion.

profiles.relationship: History changes toughness reduction at resolution
profiles.qualification: Any creature death, including opposing/token death, can establish the state. There is no direct dies trigger.

profiles.relationship: Damage to each opponent, then conditional draw on this ability's second resolution this turn
profiles.qualification: Resolution count belongs to the same ability/source history, not automatically a standalone discoverable state. Trigger count is not resolution count.

profiles.phenomenon: Own land enters; control six or more lands at resolution
profiles.relationship: Landfall response uses land count to choose token outcome
profiles.qualification: Independent land-count state can be established by other actions. Both native output branches remain uncertain in current extraction.

profiles.phenomenon: Positive +1/+1 counter placement on an own creature
profiles.relationship: Replacement increases another placement by one
profiles.qualification: Requires an existing placement opportunity. Not a triggered ability or independent placement producer.

profiles.relationship: Sacrifice activation cost, independently of removal outcome
profiles.qualification: Pay {B}, sacrifice a suitable creature, choose a legal nonblack creature target; the sacrificed creature must actually reach graveyard.
Native identity UNKNOWN remains distinct from dated external Commander legality/identity.

profiles.phenomenon: Printed ordinary tap-for-one mana on a land
profiles.qualification: Native catalog availability must be checked rather than inferred from the absence of a standalone source filename.

profiles.phenomenon: Creature taps for one green mana
profiles.relationship: Nonland mana capability versus conventional mana-dork baseline
profiles.qualification: Printed amount or presence of an ability alone cannot choose the category-relative focused-admission baseline. Original card and same-name token have different Oracle identities.

profiles.phenomenon: Artifact taps for two colorless mana
profiles.relationship: Quantity differs from ordinary one-mana land
profiles.qualification: Additional quantity is native data; no generic mana objective, baseline classifier, strategic ranking or repeatable loop is demonstrated.
